newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly lower in the after-hours session on Thursday, pressured by moderate selling in thin trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 1.2 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.2 yen lower at 139.6 yen. Volume was 5,466 lots.

During the day, the market posted moderate gains as a weak yen stimulated sporadic technical buying. But investors' selling on price rallies sent prices into negative territory in the after-hours session. "Uncertainty over the spot expiry later this month was undermining sentiment," one trader said.
